question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Agreement
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Consent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Agreement"** means a mutual understanding, arrangement, or contract between parties. (समझौता)

 
 
• **Example: **The two companies reached an agreement to collaborate on the project.
 
 
 
• **"Consent"** refers to permission for something to happen or agreement to do something. (सहमति)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave her consent to participate in the study.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Consent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Census** (जनगणना): An official count or survey of a population.

 
 
• **Example:** The government conducts a census every ten years to gather demographic data.
 
 
 
• **Puny** (निर्बल): Small and weak.
 
 
• **Example:** The puny seedlings struggled to survive in the harsh conditions.
 
 
 
• **Celibate** (ब्रह्मचारी): Abstaining from marriage and sexual relations, often for religious reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** He chose to live a celibate life dedicated to his spiritual practice.
